messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

I found your order, Shop····. It's paid and hasn't shipped yet. It has the Magic Miner 40T, the Power Kit and Harlo OS Diagnostics, and they'll ship together in one box.

I'm sorry the 40T has taken this long. We gave dates we didn't keep and didn't keep you updated well enough. A control board problem stopped production for a while. That's fixed now, and the final version is approved. Magic Miner expects all the units to leave the factory on November 12. We'll email you tracking as soon as your miner ships to you.

You can also check https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status for updates.
